visual_description: A formal document printed on heavy cream-colored paper. It features a decorative border and a Tribal Nation seal at the top. The text grants 'Paleontological Prospecting Access' for a specific window of time. It is signed by the Tribal Chairman. The paper looks slightly weathered, as if it has been carried in a field pack.

constraints.aesthetic: Dignified and formal, distinct from the bureaucratic look of the BLM forms.
constraints.logic: Represents a deeper level of cultural and legal negotiation.
